quotaFindings: Groq free GPT-OSS 20B uses an 8,000-token-per-minute window; it returned 429 when a long-context batch exceeded the window.
Groq free Qwen 3.8 27B uses a 1,000-output-token-per-minute window; a 400-token response cap plus 20-second pacing completed all eight calls.
The application must pace requests and return a controlled unavailable response at provider 429; it must not use paid fallback.
